curated-gf-rancho-gf-varta: Rancho's loose, pen-and-paper handwriting sits low, with lots of empty space above its lowercase. Varta follows in sans with wide-open eyes on every e and a, a taller, steadier partner that gives the pair its footing.
curated-gf-rancho-nunito-sans: Casual and friendly, like a note scribbled quickly. Nunito Sans, a soft sans-serif with open-mouthed curves, sits next to it in a way that feels relaxed, a good fit for, say, a reading chart sticker.
curated-gf-ranga-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: IBM Plex Sans Thai reads modern, with open c shapes. Ranga stacks above it in a dark, tightly knit stripe of unshaded outline (think personal trainer branding), so the display heading hits hard while the body keeps things light and open.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-kdam-thmor-pr: Ravi Prakash is bold and expressive, with curves as thick as its straight stems. Kdam Thmor Pro adds bowls that fill the line, and the two feel like one loud, confident voice, say, on a workwear tag.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-roboto-conden: Roboto Condensed reads tight and wiry, with barely visible gaps inside each word and a lowercase that looks enlarged. Ravi Prakash is closed and heavy up top, while the body's open letters let the page breathe underneath it.
curated-gf-ravi-prakash-gf-roboto-mono: Ravi Prakash is closed and chunky, with every curve as thick as a stem. Roboto Mono lets paper show between its letters, and that open, technical body is the pair's strongest quality against the heavy heading.
curated-gf-redacted-gf-saira-semi-conden: Redacted is packed tight, almost no slack between glyphs. It handles the loud, stubby statement, while Saira Semi Condensed supplies a steady, magnified-looking weight for the quieter text, say, in a product launch deck.
curated-gf-redressed-fs-synonym: Tiny lowercase beneath towering capitals gives Redressed its quirky, personal look. It brings bold casual handwriting, while Synonym offers a plain stripe of constant ink with generous openings in every curve (handy for a reel text overlay).
curated-gf-reggae-one-gf-goudy-booklette: Goudy Bookletter 1911 is dignified and bookish. Reggae One spaces its glyphs far apart with a brushed-watercolor shift in weight, which suits showy lines, while the serif body packs its characters shoulder to shoulder like a graveyard prop sign's quiet lettering.
curated-gf-reggae-one-gf-source-code-pro: Source Code Pro reads like typewriter text, with loosely tracked lowercase and curves that open outward. Reggae One towers above with widely spaced glyphs and soft, watercolor-like shifts in stroke, so the loose display and the precise monospace play off each other.
